topics.topic: Module responsible for refusing a run started with an unknown flow
questions: When `runs.start_run` names an unknown flow, does `module:flows` produce the unknown-reference refusal, or does `module:runs` produce it after querying `flows.active_flow_version`?

topics.topic: Ownership of random entity ID generation and collision checking
questions: Which module or capability generates and collision-checks the random identifiers used by `functions`, `bindings`, `runs` and `effects`?

topics.topic: Whether `not_sent` is an exception to the State 4 claim that the effect was sent once
questions: Does the State 4 outcome claim that a request was sent when the EffectAttempt is `not_sent`, or is `not_sent` an exception to “The effect sent once”?
